title: Jonah
author: Traditionally associated with Jonah son of Amittai.
date: Eighth century B.C. setting; final composition date uncertain.
audience: Israel, teaching God's mercy toward repentant nations.
historicalSetting: Jonah tells of God's call, Jonah's flight, Nineveh's repentance, and God's compassion.
christFocus: Jonah points to Christ through the sign of three days and through God's mercy extending beyond Israel to the nations.
